dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 52 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width of approximately 240 pixels to a vertical height of approximately 210 pixels, roughly a 1.14:1 ratio.
